offers.name: Lenovo ThinkPad P14s Gen 6 Intel Laptop, 14.5" IPS 60Hz, Intel Core Ultra 7 255H, 32GB, 512GB SSD

reviews.quote: Massive improvements thanks to Intel Arrow Lake — the P14s Gen 6 is a proper compact mobile workstation.
A portable business-driven shell that's a workstation-grade beast under the hood.

praises: Under $2,700 for a P-series ThinkPad with a 16-core Arrow Lake-H CPU — cheapest entry into the certified-workstation line
iGPU config runs cool and quiet with the best battery of the P14s range
Proper ThinkPad build, keyboard and TrackPoint at a mainstream business-laptop price
RAM and storage are upgradeable SODIMM/M.2 despite the low price
Fine for 2D CAD, drafting review, Office and coding multitasking with 32GB
complaints: Intel Arc iGPU lacks the RTX PRO certification buyers pick the P-line for — heavy 3D CAD stutters
512GB SSD needs an upgrade almost immediately for project files
Entry 60Hz IPS panel with modest color coverage
At regular $3,400 it's overpriced; the $2,659 sale is the only good buy
No verified CA pro review of this exact iGPU configuration

design_philosophy: The absolute floor of the P-series: a ThinkPad P14s chassis with integrated Arc graphics instead of a certified RTX PRO GPU, sold to students and drafting shops that want ThinkPad durability, capacity headroom, and P-line serviceability at commodity-business pricing. Real 3D workstation work is out of scope for this tier.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from sibling entry 37 (SHARED-thinkpad-p.md, no verified pro anchor): iGPU instead of RTX PRO 500 → creative_work 5.5 (no discrete cert), ai_ml 4.2, gaming 3.5 (Arc iGPU class ~3.5 per dataset anchors), +0.5 battery / +1.0 thermals_noise for fan-cool iGPU tier.
